mapper.select: INSERT INTO problem_review_card ( user_id, problem_slug, source, source_detail_json, repetitions, interval_days, fsrs_state, fsrs_step, fsrs_stability, fsrs_difficulty, due_at, lapses, last_reviewed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{problemSlug}, #{source}, #{sourceDetailJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{repetitions}, #{intervalDays}, #{fsrsState}, #{fsrsStep}, #{fsrsStability}, #{fsrsDifficulty}, #{dueAt}, #{lapses}, #{lastReviewedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, problem_slug) DO UPDATE SET source = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN 'REVIEW_FAILED' WHEN problem_review_card.source = 'USER_MARKED' THEN EXCLUDED.source ELSE problem_review_card.source END, source_detail_json = EXCLUDED.source_detail_json, repetitions = CASE WHEN problem_review_card.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE problem_review_card.repetitions END, interval_days = CASE WHEN problem_review_card.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE problem_review_card.interval_days END, fsrs_state = CASE WHEN problem_review_card.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN EXCLUDED.fsrs_state ELSE problem_review_card.fsrs_state END, fsrs_step = CASE WHEN problem_review_card.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN EXCLUDED.fsrs_step ELSE problem_review_card.fsrs_step END, fsrs_stability = CASE WHEN problem_review_card.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN EXCLUDED.fsrs_stability ELSE problem_review_card.fsrs_stability END, fsrs_difficulty = CASE WHEN problem_review_card.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN EXCLUDED.fsrs_difficulty ELSE problem_review_card.fsrs_difficulty END, due_at = CASE WHEN problem_review_card.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN EXCLUDED.due_at ELSE problem_review_card.due_at END, last_reviewed_at = CASE WHEN problem_review_card.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN EXCLUDED.last_reviewed_at ELSE problem_review_card.last_reviewed_at END, lapses = CASE WHEN problem_review_card.source = 'REVIEW_PASSED' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' THEN problem_review_card.lapses + 1 ELSE problem_review_card.lapses END, archived = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING

INSERT INTO problem_review_card ( user_id, problem_slug, source, source_detail_json, due_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{problemSlug}, #{source}, #{sourceDetailJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{now}, #{now}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, problem_slug) DO UPDATE SET source_detail_json = problem_review_card.source_detail_json || EXCLUDED.source_detail_json, archived = FALSE, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at RETURNING

SELECT FROM problem_review_card WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND archived = FALSE AND due_at <= #{now} ORDER BY CASE fsrs_state WHEN 'RELEARNING' THEN 0 WHEN 'LEARNING' THEN 1 WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, (source = 'REVIEW_FAILED' OR lapses > 0) DESC, due_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE problem_review_card SET repetitions = #{repetitions}, interval_days = #{intervalDays}, fsrs_state = #{fsrsState}, fsrs_step = #{fsrsStep}, fsrs_stability = #{fsrsStability}, fsrs_difficulty = #{fsrsDifficulty}, lapses = #{lapses}, due_at = #{dueAt}, last_rating = #{lastRating}, last_reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = #{reviewedAt} WHERE id = #{cardId} AND user_id = #{userId} RETURNING
